gameSystem.name: Vampire: The Masquerade — Night Court
gameSystem.description: An unofficial sandbox chronicle for one player: build a city of the Kindred, then survive its court, your Hunger and the hunters, night by night.

credits.notice: Night Court is unofficial fan content and not official World of Darkness material; its text was written with the help of generative AI. entries.text: A faction makes its move
An ally is in trouble
Someone new arrives in the city
A touchstone's life shifts
Someone is asking the wrong questions

tables.name: What trouble is your ally in?

entries.text: A debt to a dangerous elder has come due.
Their haven was found; they need a new one before dawn.
They broke the Masquerade, and someone has proof.
A mortal they love is in a hospital, asking for them.
They are being blackmailed by a ghoul who knows too much.
They vanished two nights ago; their phone still rings.
A Toreador fleeing a fallen court
An Anarch courier with a sealed message
A Nosferatu who already knows your name
A thin-blooded stray, starving
An archon on the Prince's business
A hunter wearing a priest's collar
A packed club where no one remembers faces.
A hospital night shift, tired and careless.
The river walk, lonely after midnight.
A rooftop party above the old town.
An all-night diner full of regulars.
A shelter where you once volunteered, alive.
Hunger: until you feed, every scene bends toward blood.
Dominance: you must win the next argument or contest, whatever it costs.
Harm: you lash out at whoever stands closest, in word or deed.
Paranoia: everyone is a threat; trust no one until the night ends.
Your clan's curse: play the Compulsion of your clan.
Your clan's curse: play the Compulsion of your clan.

setup.prompt: The Camarilla, the Anarchs, or a court of your own making.

sceneTypes.tips: Write one free fact per faction.

flows.name: Chronicle
flows.description: A sandbox chronicle: build the city, then play it night by night.
flows.introduction: Session Zero builds the city, its court and your Kindred. After that, each session starts from what you want, and the city answers between scenes.

sessionOpening.title: What do you want this session?
sessionOpening.prompt: Your ambition: {fact:ambition}. What do you want this session?

sessionClosing.title: Did you get what you wanted this session?

worldTurn.tip: On 1 to 3 the night stays quiet.
